Metadata.Title: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: Unlocks the frame rate from 30 to 60 FPS. Game logic uses measured delta time, so game speed is unaffected. Tested on PS4 Pro only; minor frame drops in some areas.
Metadata.Author: NaughtyCoffeeHamster

Metadata.Title: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS + loading screen fix
Metadata.Note: Same as 60 FPS, plus the fixed loading screen animation step is changed from 1/30 s to 1/60 s so it does not run too fast. Use instead of the plain 60 FPS patch, not together with it. Briefly tested on PS4 Pro only; no crashes found.
Metadata.Author: NaughtyCoffeeHamster

Metadata.Title: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
Metadata.Name: Resolution 2560x1440 (experimental)
Metadata.Note: Raises the hard-coded 1920x1080 resolution to 2560x1440. Can be combined with a 60 FPS patch. Briefly tested on PS4 Pro only: seemed fairly stable with 60 FPS. Not tested across the whole game or on base PS4.
Metadata.Author: NaughtyCoffeeHamster

Metadata.Title: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
Metadata.Name: Resolution 3840x2160 (experimental)
Metadata.Note: Raises the hard-coded 1920x1080 resolution to 3840x2160 (native 4K). Can be combined with a 60 FPS patch. Briefly tested on PS4 Pro only: runs with 60 FPS but with more frame drops and higher temperatures than 1440p. Not tested across the whole game or on base PS4.
Metadata.Author: NaughtyCoffeeHamster
